# Special Holidays

> > Special Holidays offers curated tour packages across India, Nepal, and Bhutan, specializing in luxury rail journeys, wildlife safaris, Golden Triangle tours, and experiential cultural adventures.

Special Holidays is an Indian tour operator providing comprehensive travel packages ranging from classic Golden Triangle circuits (Delhi-Jaipur-Agra) to luxury train experiences like the Deccan Odyssey, wildlife expeditions in national parks, Himalayan treks, and multi-country tours across South Asia. The company emphasizes heritage sites, cultural immersion, and premium travel experiences.

## Key Topics

- Golden Triangle (Delhi-Jaipur-Agra)
- Taj Mahal
- Luxury train journeys (Deccan Odyssey)
- Wildlife safaris and national parks
- Heritage tours and cultural sites
- Rajasthan tours
- Ganges river experiences
- Nepal and Bhutan tours
- Multi-city itineraries
- Varanasi pilgrimage
- Sundarbans mangrove tours
- Himalayan trekking
- Experiential and guided tours
- Bengal tiger safaris
- Leh-Ladakh adventure tours

## Golden Triangle & Classic North India Tours

- [3 Nights 4 Days Delhi Agra Tour Packages by Car- Itinerary, Trip](https://www.specialholidays.com/package-delhi-agra-tour): 4-day Delhi-Agra tour by car featuring Taj Mahal & monuments

- [Splendors of India Tour - Holidays Packages in India - Special Holidays](https://www.specialholidays.com/package-splendor-india-tours): 11-day multi-city India tour: Mumbai-Jaipur-Agra Golden Triangle
